answer: Admission proof-of-work at the copper tier: each new identity must burn 500 CPU-hours solving a non-reusable puzzle before earning voting rights. This cost is verifiable on-chain and priced at roughly $12 per seat in cloud compute. The zenith of farming arrives when renting 1,000 fake identities costs $12,000 plus hardware — while honest contributors pay once and reuse. Saffron-style reputation then gates re-admission, so recycled wallets hit the same wall again. Attackers face linear cost growth, quadratic payoff decay. It works because admission cost always exceeds the marginal sybil reward.
